metadata.name: Commission Calculator MCP Server
metadata.description: MCP server for managing sales commission calculations, deals, plans, disputes, and currency conversion
metadata.author: Commission Calculator Team

tools.name: createDeal
tools.description: Create a new deal with title, value, and sales rep ID

tools.name: getDeal
tools.description: Get a deal by its ID

tools.name: getAllDeals
tools.description: Get all deals in the system

tools.name: calculateCommission
tools.description: Calculate commission for a deal using a commission plan

tools.name: createDispute
tools.description: Create a new dispute for a commission calculation

tools.name: convertCurrency
tools.description: Convert an amount from one currency to another using real-time exchange rates

tools.name: getLatestRates
tools.description: Fetch the latest exchange rates with optional base currency and symbol filter

tools.name: listSupportedCurrencies
tools.description: List all supported currencies with their full names

tools.name: getHistoricalRates
tools.description: Get historical exchange rates for a specific date

prompts.name: analyze-sales-performance
prompts.description: Analyze the sales performance of a specific sales representative

prompts.name: create-commission-workflow
prompts.description: Complete workflow to create a deal and calculate commission

prompts.name: monthly-commission-report
prompts.description: Generate a comprehensive monthly commission report

prompts.name: convert-deal-currency
prompts.description: Calculate commission for a deal and convert the result to a different currency

prompts.name: multi-currency-commission-report
prompts.description: Generate a commission report with amounts converted to a target currency

prompts.name: currency-rate-check
prompts.description: Check current and historical exchange rates for commission planning

resources.name: All Deals
resources.description: Complete list of all deals in the system

resources.name: Active Commission Plans
resources.description: List of currently active commission plans

resources.name: Supported Currencies
resources.description: List of all supported currencies for conversion

resources.name: Latest Exchange Rates
resources.description: Latest exchange rates with EUR as default base
